items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: Any guy in that band, dear friends, cohorts. Gene Allen played baritone, Wally Kane, Al Bach, Harvey Estin, that’s the reed section

ctx.x: I would say it has to. Who were some of your most favorite fellow musicians that you associated with?

Well I would start off by saying the guys in the Sauter-Finegan band. Any guy in that band, dear friends, cohorts. Gene Allen played baritone, Wally Kane, Al Bach, Harvey Estin, that’s the reed section, Sonny Russo — I could go through the whole band. Joe Ferrante, Nick Travis, Bobby Nichols, Tommy Mitchell. The whole list, the whole Sauter-Finegan band. But there were a lot of New York musicians, Clark Terry, Milt Hinton, Joe [inaudible], Sol Gubin, Urbie Green — Urbie was soloist in the Sauter- Finegan band on…
What was the racial atmosphere during your tenure in New York as far as the studio work, and playing in clubs and that kind of thing?
